shellCommands.command: cat package.json; ls; ls app src 2>/dev/null; git status --short; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; grep -rl "refresh" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -30

cat app/page.tsx; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/ | grep -i -E "refresh|revalidate|update"; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/refresh.md 2>/dev/null
ls node_modules/server-only 2>&1 | head -2; npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -20; echo tsc=$?
npx tsc --noEmit -p . ; echo tsc=$?; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -15; echo build=$?
npx tsc --noEmit -p . ; echo tsc=$?; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -12; echo build=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
